hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each batch entry against the same static available_quantity, so a cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item (OVS-PIECE x6 plus OVS-TWOPACK x3 = 12 units against 10 stocked) should pass the reservation check during complete-cart and create an order whose needed units exceed stock. I expect the single cart to complete successfully, producing an order that needs 12 WIDGET units against 10 stocked, which fails no_oversell (b), and reserved_matches_reservations should still pass since the summed counter matches the rows.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: bundle-shared-widget-oversell
description: One cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item needs 12 units against 10 stocked; the batch reservation should reject it.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1
stock:
  WIDGET: 10
carts:
  bundle-buyer:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-PIECE
      qty: 6
    - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
      qty: 3
race:
- id: bundle-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: bundle-buyer
timing:
  release: together
faults: []
runs: 10
seed: 1
